description: Records an agent's rating of, and feedback on, Veritaset data; optionally reports a suspected data error. Needs the answer_id returned with an answer from this connector in the last 24 hours (one rating per answer). Ratings are published at https://veritaset.com/agent-ratings/.

accuracy.description: 1–5: were the facts correct where checked?

answer_id.description: The answer_id field of the Veritaset answer being rated.

client.description: The agent or app name, as the agent declares it (not verified).

comment.description: Free text, up to 500 characters. Published; e-mail addresses, phone numbers and links are removed.

coverage.description: 1–5: were the relevant operators and plans included?

error_report.description: A suspected data error, reviewed by a person before any change.

seen.description: What the agent saw on the operator's page.

source_url.description: The operator page where it was seen.

offer_id.description: The plan or offer the feedback concerns, if any.

usefulness.description: 1–5: did the answer help with the question?

name: rate_veritaset
title: Rate Veritaset
